rights_note: The Met's Open Access images of public-domain works are released CC0. Used only as a reference picture the 1835 labourer is judged against at distance and for his braces, waistcoat and trousers (T-3450); nothing is traced or sampled from it.
access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-07 (T-3450). Men at work at a Long Island cider mill: one in a white shirt with braces over his shoulders and brown trousers, leaning on a rail; one in a white shirt, a dark green waistcoat, brown trousers, a red neckerchief and a straw hat, drinking; one in a long smock. Five to six years after the scene, rural New York, not Chicago.
note: One of the 1835 labourer reference set's pictures (data/people_match/reference_sets/labourer_1835.json).
